title: PoE2 0.2.0e: Act 3 Layouts, Attribute Runes and Player Balance
summary: 0.2.0e shortened Act 3 by removing dead ends in Drowned City, Utzaal, Apex of Filth and Azak Bog, introduced Attribute Runes, and applied player-balance changes affecting Huntress, minions, skills and ascendancies.
description: 0.2.0e explained: Act 3 route changes, Attribute Runes, player balance groups, Spectre/Remnant fixes and what still applies in 0.5.4e.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: Attribute runes socketed into an item.

currentSummary: The shortened Act 3 layout from 0.2.0e is still the campaign structure in 0.5.4e.
Attribute Runes from 0.2.0e were expanded by later patches; current rune effects must be checked against the live client.

sections.title: Quick summary
paragraphs: 0.2.0e is a campaign and balance patch. It cut backtracking in Act 3 by removing dead ends in Drowned City, Utzaal, Apex of Filth and Azak Bog, which is why old Act 3 route videos no longer match.
It introduced Attribute Runes, applied player-balance changes touching Huntress, minions, skills and ascendancies, and fixed Spectre and Remnant skill interactions that had broken some builds.

sections.title: Historical warning
sections.era: Path of Exile 2 Early Access — the 0.2.0 era
paragraphs: 0.2.0e shortened a launch-era campaign area. Its Attribute Runes were a first version; later patches expanded the rune system.

items.title: Attribute Runes
items.detail: A new rune category introduced in 0.2.0e that granted attribute bonuses when socketed. Later patches expanded the rune system, so current effects differ from launch.

sections.title: Balance impact
paragraphs: The player-balance pass touched Huntress, minions, skills and ascendancies, so any build guide written before 0.2.0e may under- or over-state certain interactions.
Spectre and Remnant skill-interaction fixes restored builds that relied on those mechanics.

sections.oldText: Videos show longer loops with dead ends that no longer exist, so following them wastes time.
sections.newText: Dead ends are gone and the areas are shorter; current route guides reflect the live layout.

items.question: Why doesn't my old Act 3 video match the game?
answer: 0.2.0e removed dead ends in Drowned City, Utzaal, Apex of Filth and Azak Bog, shortening the act. Use current route guides.

items.question: Did Attribute Runes exist at 0.2.0 launch?
answer: No. Attribute Runes were introduced in 0.2.0e; later patches expanded the rune system, so check current effects.
